name: Renquishausen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Renquishausen (a white cockerel on red under a white chief).
history: Municipal flag of Renquishausen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Renquishausen arms — white cockerel on red
